name: Does converting PDF to JPG upload my file?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree converts PDF pages to images entirely in your browser using PDF.js. Nothing is uploaded.

name: What image quality can I expect?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree renders PDF pages at high resolution (150–300 DPI). You can select the output quality level.

name: Can I convert only specific pages to JPG?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can select individual pages or a page range to convert.

name: Is there a page limit for conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There are no page count or file size limits.
